            if (r, c) in me or (r, c) in opponent:

            # Check if placing here is legal (has at least one liberty)

            has_liberty = False

            # Check all four directions

            for dr, dc in [(-1,0), (1,0), (0,-1), (0,1)]:

                nr = r + dr

                nc = c + dc

                if 1 <= nr <= 19 and 1 <= nc <= 19:

                    if (nr, nc) not in me and (nr, nc) not in opponent:

    # Now select the best move from candidates

    # Precompute for each candidate the number of adjacent opponent stones and distance from center

    candidate_scores = []

    for (r, c) in candidates:

        # Count opponent stones adjacent

        op_count = 0

        for dr, dc in [(-1,0), (1,0), (0,-1), (0,1)]:

            nr = r + dr

            nc = c + dc

            if 1 <= nr <= 19 and 1 <= nc <= 19:
